unmeasured: retrieval quality for inline fixture questions

live_mode.detail: Mock results are deterministic plumbing fixtures.

complete_run.detail: Budget exhaustion, cancellation, or interrupted work cannot qualify a partial study.

release_audit.detail: Audit every final response, including conflict and abstention text; zero observed material unsupported responses.

repeatability.detail: A predeclared twenty-question, three-repetition live artifact is required.

held_out_sample.detail: Require exactly 140 answerable, 40 missing-evidence, and 20 conflict questions from 20 held-out families.

live_completion.detail: At least 198/200 complete with an answer or valid abstention; technical failures stay in the denominator.

conflict_handling.detail: Require at least 19/20 appropriate final responses.

controlled_sample.detail: Require a one-to-one match of 200 supported originals and 200 reviewed unsupported mutations, 25 per error category.

retrieval_coverage.detail: At least 126/140 cases need all required evidence in the packed top eight.

correct_and_complete.detail: D needs at least 105/140 correct-complete answers, at most seven fewer than A.

multi_evidence_cases.detail: At least 40 held-out answerable cases need a multi-evidence label and at least two required facts with distinct gold spans.

mandatory_fault_suite.detail: A reviewed, policy-bound mandatory fault-suite artifact is not supplied by this evaluation runner.

frozen_primary_profile.detail: Freeze and preselect the verifier profile on development data before held-out execution.

frozen_before_execution.detail: The held-out dataset and selected policy must be frozen before the first study call.

frozen_corpus_snapshots.detail: Every question for a corpus must observe the same frozen embedding space and active-source revision.

live_concurrent_latency.detail: Paired replay does not establish live p95 at four concurrent requests; a separate live load result is required.

real_evaluation_dataset.detail: Synthetic demo labels are not independent human-reviewed gold.

missing_evidence_handling.detail: Require at least 38/40 appropriate final responses.

controlled_false_acceptance.detail: At most 10/200 unsupported original challenge claims accepted; no repair.

all_outputs_independently_reviewed.detail: Independently review all distinct initial, repaired, and final answers, blind to verdict and variant.

question_and_controlled_gold_reviewed.detail: Two independent reviewers must adjudicate question/evidence gold and controlled labels.

qualification.qualification_note: Engineering completion is separate from model quality. No production policy is auto-issued from fixtures or replay metrics.

dataset_manifest.notes: Seven inline-evidence questions and sixteen controlled claims. No corpus retrieval is performed by these evaluation questions. All facts are fictional. No independent human review, model quality, natural error prevalence or production readiness is claimed. Fixture markers intentionally exercise deterministic mock branches.
